Tinatanggap pa rin kung hindi talaga posible sa oras, pero hindi lalampas sa 1 taon mula sa petsa ng pagkawala (Proof of Loss, p. 42). Nakasaad din sa claim form ang 90-araw na limitasyon, at pagkatapos nito ay maaaring ituring na abandonado ang claim.

input: Hanggang kailan ang pag-submit ng claim documents?
output: Ang written proof of loss (original policy o certificate, original receipts, invoices at iba pang docs) ay dapat ma-submit within 90 days after the loss. Tatanggapin pa rin kung talagang hindi kaya on time, pero hindi lalagpas ng 1 year mula sa date of loss (Proof of Loss, p. 42). Sa claim form, after 90 days pwedeng ituring na abandoned ang claim.

input: What documents are required for every claim?
output: Per the Notification of Claim checklist: the duly accomplished Notification of Claim form, a copy of the insurance policy, a request letter for reimbursement, original official receipts of all payments, and a copy of your passport with exit/entry dates. The insurer may request additional documents (Claim Form checklist; Proof of Loss, p. 42).

input: Anong mga dokumento ang kailangan sa bawat claim?
output: Ayon sa checklist ng Notification of Claim: ang nasagutang Notification of Claim form, kopya ng insurance policy, request letter para sa reimbursement, orihinal na opisyal na resibo ng lahat ng bayad, at kopya ng pasaporte na may exit/entry dates. Maaaring humingi ang insurer ng dagdag na dokumento (Claim Form checklist; Proof of Loss, p. 42).

input: Ano yung required documents sa lahat ng claims?
output: Base sa Notification of Claim checklist: filled-out Notification of Claim form, copy ng policy, request letter for reimbursement, original official receipts ng lahat ng binayaran, at copy ng passport na may exit/entry stamps. Pwede pa humingi ng additional docs ang insurer (Claim Form checklist; Proof of Loss, p. 42).

input: What extra documents do I need for a medical or hospitalization claim?
output: In addition to the compulsory documents: a medical report with admitting history, clinical/laboratory results, an itemized statement of account, operative or histopathology report if applicable, a registered death certificate if applicable, and a dental report for emergency dental care. The Attending Physician Statement section of the claim form should be completed by the doctor (Claim Form checklist).

input: Anong dagdag na dokumento ang kailangan para sa medical o hospitalization claim?
output: Bukod sa mga compulsory na dokumento: medical report na may admitting history, clinical/laboratory results, itemized na statement of account, operative o histopathology report kung mayroon, rehistradong death certificate kung kailangan, at dental report para sa emergency dental care. Dapat sagutan ng doktor ang Attending Physician Statement sa claim form (Claim Form checklist).

input: Anong additional docs ang need sa medical claim?
output: Bukod sa compulsory docs: medical report with admitting history, lab results, itemized statement of account, operative o histopath report kung meron, death certificate kung applicable, at dental report sa emergency dental. Dapat i-fill out ng doctor ang Attending Physician Statement sa claim form (Claim Form checklist).

input: What documents do I need for a lost or delayed luggage claim?
output: A Property Irregularity Report (PIR) or Baggage Damage Report from the airline, your incident report, and original receipts of basic necessities you bought, plus the compulsory documents (Claim Form checklist). For theft, add the police report filed within 24 hours (Section 14, p. 27).

input: Anong dokumento ang kailangan para sa claim ng nawala o naantalang bagahe?
output: Property Irregularity Report (PIR) o Baggage Damage Report mula sa airline, ang iyong incident report, at orihinal na resibo ng mga pangunahing pangangailangang binili mo, kasama ang compulsory na dokumento (Claim Form checklist). Kung nanakaw, idagdag ang police report na ginawa sa loob ng 24 oras (Section 14, p. 27).

input: Anong docs ang need sa lost o delayed luggage claim?
output: Property Irregularity Report (PIR) o Baggage Damage Report galing airline, incident report mo, at original receipts ng basic necessities na binili mo, plus compulsory docs (Claim Form checklist). Kung nanakaw, isama ang police report na na-file within 24 hours (Section 14, p. 27).

input: How long does it take to get paid after my claim is approved?
output: Payment is made within 30 days after the Company receives the written proof of loss and the loss amount is agreed. If agreement is not reached within 60 days, the loss is paid within 90 days of receipt. Late payment without a fraud ground earns interest at twice the Monetary Board ceiling (Time of Payment of Claim, pp. 42-43).

input: Gaano katagal bago ako mabayaran matapos maaprubahan ang claim?
output: Babayaran sa loob ng 30 araw matapos matanggap ng Kompanya ang nakasulat na proof of loss at magkasundo sa halaga. Kung hindi magkasundo sa loob ng 60 araw, babayaran ang pagkawala sa loob ng 90 araw mula sa pagtanggap. Kapag naantala ang bayad nang walang dahilang pandaraya, may interes na doble sa ceiling ng Monetary Board (Time of Payment of Claim, pp. 42-43).

input: Gaano katagal bago ma-release ang bayad sa claim?
output: Babayaran within 30 days after matanggap ng Company ang proof of loss at ma-agree ang amount. Kung walang agreement within 60 days, babayaran within 90 days of receipt. Kung late ang bayad at hindi dahil sa fraud, may interest na twice the Monetary Board ceiling (Time of Payment of Claim, pp. 42-43).

input: Who receives the claim payment if the insured dies?
output: The designated beneficiary, if not legally disqualified and still living. If none, payment goes in this order: legal spouse, children, parents, brothers and sisters, otherwise the insured's estate (To Whom Claims Paid, p. 42).

input: Sino ang tatanggap ng bayad sa claim kung mamatay ang insured?
output: Ang itinalagang beneficiary, kung hindi diskwalipikado at buhay pa. Kung wala, babayaran ayon sa pagkakasunod: legal na asawa, mga anak, mga magulang, mga kapatid, kung wala ay sa estate ng insured (To Whom Claims Paid, p. 42).

input: Sino ang makakatanggap ng claim kung namatay ang insured?
output: Yung designated beneficiary, kung hindi disqualified at buhay pa. Kung wala, ganito ang order: legal spouse, children, parents, brothers at sisters, otherwise sa estate ng insured (To Whom Claims Paid, p. 42).

input: Does submitting all documents guarantee my claim will be approved?
output: No. The claim form states that submitting the required documents does not guarantee approval; documents are reviewed subject to the limits, terms and conditions of your policy. This chatbot also cannot approve or deny claims (Claim Form instructions; Terms and Conditions, p. 45).

input: Garantiya bang maaaprubahan ang claim ko kung kumpleto ang dokumento?
output: Hindi. Nakasaad sa claim form na hindi garantiya ng pag-apruba ang pagsusumite ng mga dokumento; susuriin ang mga ito ayon sa limits, tuntunin at kondisyon ng iyong policy. Hindi rin kayang aprubahan o tanggihan ng chatbot na ito ang claim (Claim Form instructions; Terms and Conditions, p. 45).

input: Sure na ba ma-approve ang claim ko pag kumpleto docs?
output: Hindi. Sabi sa claim form, hindi guarantee ng approval ang pag-submit ng docs; ire-review pa base sa limits, terms at conditions ng policy mo. Hindi rin kaya ng chatbot na ito na mag-approve o mag-deny ng claim (Claim Form instructions; Terms and Conditions, p. 45).

input: I have another travel insurance. Can I claim from both?
output: You must tell the Company about other insurance covering the same risks. Except for Personal Accident, if other valid insurance exists, Travel Shield pays only the excess over what the other insurance pays, less any deductible (Cumulative Insurances, p. 43). You can also only be covered under one Travel Shield policy for the same trip (General Provisions b, p. 40).

input: May iba pa akong travel insurance. Pwede ba akong mag-claim sa dalawa?
output: Dapat mong ipaalam sa Kompanya ang iba pang insurance na sumasagot sa parehong panganib. Maliban sa Personal Accident, kung may iba pang balidong insurance, ang sobra lamang sa binayaran ng ibang insurance ang sasagutin ng Travel Shield, bawas ang deductible (Cumulative Insurances, p. 43). Isa lamang na Travel Shield policy ang maaaring sumagot sa iisang biyahe (General Provisions b, p. 40).

input: May iba pa akong travel insurance. Pwede ba mag-claim sa pareho?
output: Kailangan mo i-declare sa Company ang ibang insurance na may same coverage. Except sa Personal Accident, kung may ibang valid insurance, yung excess lang sa nabayaran ng other insurance ang babayaran ng Travel Shield, less deductible (Cumulative Insurances, p. 43). Isang Travel Shield policy lang din per trip (General Provisions b, p. 40).

input: How will I receive the money if my claim is approved?
output: On the claim form you name the payee for the check, or give bank details for a direct credit to your nominated account. Check is the default for amounts above the threshold on the form, inter-branch crediting costs may be deducted, and a processing fee applies if you give incorrect information. Amounts are computed in Philippine Pesos at the exchange rate when the expense was incurred (Claim Form; Currency, p. 41).

input: Paano ko matatanggap ang pera kung maaprubahan ang claim?
output: Sa claim form, ilalagay mo ang pangalan ng payee sa tseke, o ang detalye ng bangko para sa direct credit sa iyong account. Tseke ang default para sa halagang lampas sa threshold sa form, maaaring ibawas ang gastos sa inter-branch crediting, at may processing fee kung mali ang ibinigay mong impormasyon. Kinukuwenta ang halaga sa Philippine Peso gamit ang palitan noong gumastos ka (Claim Form; Currency, p. 41).

input: Paano ko makukuha ang pera pag na-approve ang claim?
output: Sa claim form, ilalagay mo ang payee name para sa check, o bank details para sa direct credit sa account mo. Check ang default kung lampas sa threshold sa form, pwedeng ibawas ang inter-branch crediting fee, at may processing fee kung mali ang info na binigay mo. Computed in Philippine Pesos sa exchange rate nung gumastos ka (Claim Form; Currency, p. 41).

input: I want to file a claim now. Can you help me fill out the form?
output: Yes. Open the Claim Assistant tab: it follows the official Notification of Claim form (insured and claimant information, type of loss, injury or sickness details, official receipts, payee and bank details, declaration), shows the document checklist for your type of loss, and emails the completed form with your attachments to the claims team.

input: Gusto kong mag-file ng claim ngayon. Matutulungan mo ba akong sagutan ang form?
output: Oo. Buksan ang Claim Assistant tab: sinusunod nito ang opisyal na Notification of Claim form (impormasyon ng insured at claimant, uri ng pagkawala, detalye ng pinsala o sakit, opisyal na resibo, payee at detalye ng bangko, deklarasyon), ipinapakita ang checklist ng dokumento para sa uri ng iyong claim, at ini-email ang nasagutang form kasama ang mga attachment sa claims team.

input: Gusto ko na mag-file ng claim. Pwede mo ba ako tulungan mag-fill out ng form?
output: Yes. Punta ka sa Claim Assistant tab: sinusundan nito ang official Notification of Claim form (insured at claimant info, type of loss, injury o sickness details, official receipts, payee at bank details, declaration), pinapakita ang document checklist para sa type of loss mo, at ine-email ang completed form at attachments sa claims team.

input: Can I get a refund if I cancel my trip and policy?
output: If you cancel a trip before the policy's effective date or within 30 days after it and notify the Company, the premium paid for that trip is refunded less documentary stamp and premium taxes. For other cancellations by the policyholder, the Company keeps a share of the annual premium: 40% at 2 months, 50% at 3, 60% at 4, 70% at 5, 75% at 6, and 100% after 6 months (Cancellation, p. 44).

input: Makakakuha ba ako ng refund kung kanselahin ko ang biyahe at policy?
output: Kung kanselahin mo ang biyahe bago ang effective date o sa loob ng 30 araw matapos ito at ipinaalam sa Kompanya, ibabalik ang premium para sa biyaheng iyon bawas ang documentary stamp at premium taxes. Sa ibang pagkansela ng policyholder, kukunin ng Kompanya ang bahagi ng annual premium: 40% sa 2 buwan, 50% sa 3, 60% sa 4, 70% sa 5, 75% sa 6, at 100% lampas 6 na buwan (Cancellation, p. 44).

input: May refund ba kung i-cancel ko ang trip at policy ko?
output: Kung i-cancel mo ang trip bago ang effective date o within 30 days after at in-inform mo ang Company, ire-refund ang premium ng trip na yun minus documentary stamp at premium taxes. Sa ibang cancellation ng policyholder, may retained na percentage ng annual premium: 40% sa 2 months, 50% sa 3, 60% sa 4, 70% sa 5, 75% sa 6, at 100% after 6 months (Cancellation, p. 44).

input: Is there a free look period?
output: Yes: 15 days for policies effective more than 6 months, and 5 days for policies of 6 months or less but longer than 30 days, with a full premium refund. It does not apply to short-term travel policies of up to 30 days, after the trip has started, if a claim was already made, or to group contracts (Free Look Provision, p. 46).

input: May free look period ba?
output: Oo: 15 araw para sa policy na higit 6 na buwan, at 5 araw para sa 6 na buwan o mas maikli pero higit 30 araw, na may buong refund ng premium. Hindi ito para sa short-term travel policy na hanggang 30 araw, kapag nagsimula na ang biyahe, kung may claim na, o sa group contract (Free Look Provision, p. 46).

input: May free look period ba ang policy?
output: Yes: 15 days kung more than 6 months ang policy, at 5 days kung 6 months or less pero more than 30 days, full refund ng premium. Hindi applicable sa short-term travel policies na up to 30 days, kung nag-start na ang trip, kung may claim na, o sa group contracts (Free Look Provision, p. 46).

input: When does my policy become valid?
output: Only once the premium is paid and the Company issues an official receipt signed by its official or authorized agent (Premium Payment, p. 41). No insurance is in force unless the Policy Schedule or Travel Itinerary Page is signed by an authorized representative (p. 4).

input: Kailan nagiging balido ang aking policy?
output: Kapag nabayaran na ang premium at nag-isyu ang Kompanya ng opisyal na resibo na pinirmahan ng opisyal o awtorisadong ahente (Premium Payment, p. 41). Walang bisa ang insurance hangga't hindi pinipirmahan ng awtorisadong kinatawan ang Policy Schedule o Travel Itinerary Page (p. 4).

input: Kailan nagiging valid ang policy ko?
output: Pag bayad na ang premium at may official receipt na pinirmahan ng official o authorized agent (Premium Payment, p. 41). Walang bisa ang insurance hangga't hindi signed ng authorized representative ang Policy Schedule o Travel Itinerary Page (p. 4).

input: What can I do if I disagree with the insurer's decision on my claim?
output: Disputes go first to mediation administered by the Insurance Commission or a recognized mediation institution, then to arbitration under the Philippine Dispute Resolution Center rules. Legal action can be filed only 60 days after proof of loss, and not later than 12 months from notice of denial (Arbitration and Legal Action, p. 46). The Insurance Commission can also assist (p. 47).

input: Ano ang magagawa ko kung hindi ako sang-ayon sa desisyon ng insurer sa aking claim?
output: Ang hindi pagkakasundo ay dadaan muna sa mediation ng Insurance Commission o kinikilalang mediation institution, bago sa arbitration ayon sa patakaran ng Philippine Dispute Resolution Center. Maaari lamang magsampa ng kaso 60 araw matapos ang proof of loss, at hindi lalampas sa 12 buwan mula sa abiso ng pagtanggi (Arbitration and Legal Action, p. 46). Maaari ring tumulong ang Insurance Commission (p. 47).

input: Ano pwede ko gawin kung hindi ako agree sa decision sa claim ko?
output: Unahin ang mediation sa Insurance Commission o recognized mediation institution, tapos arbitration under Philippine Dispute Resolution Center rules. Pwede lang mag-file ng legal action after 60 days ng proof of loss, at hindi lalagpas ng 12 months mula sa notice of denial (Arbitration and Legal Action, p. 46). Pwede ring tumulong ang Insurance Commission (p. 47).

input: I paid hospital bills in US dollars. In what currency will I be reimbursed?
output: Amounts are in Philippine Pesos unless your Policy Schedule specifies otherwise. Foreign currency expenses are converted at the exchange rate at the time the expense was incurred or the loss occurred (Currency, p. 41).

input: Nagbayad ako ng ospital sa US dollar. Sa anong pera ako ire-reimburse?
output: Ang halaga ay nasa Philippine Peso maliban kung iba ang nakasaad sa iyong Policy Schedule. Ang gastos sa dayuhang pera ay kukuwentahin sa palitan noong panahong ginastos o nangyari ang pagkawala (Currency, p. 41).

input: Naka-dollars yung binayaran ko sa hospital. Anong currency ang reimbursement?
output: Philippine Pesos ang amounts unless iba ang nakalagay sa Policy Schedule mo. Ang foreign currency expenses ay iko-convert sa exchange rate nung time na gumastos ka o nangyari ang loss (Currency, p. 41).

input: What happens if a claim is found to be fraudulent?
output: The Company has no liability for that claim and may terminate the policy immediately. Any intentional misstatement in the application is also fraud and allows immediate termination (Fraud and Fraudulent Claims, p. 45).

input: Ano ang mangyayari kung mapatunayang mapanlinlang ang claim?
output: Walang pananagutan ang Kompanya sa claim na iyon at maaari nitong agad na tapusin ang policy. Ang sinadyang maling pahayag sa application ay pandaraya rin at dahilan para agad itong tapusin (Fraud at Fraudulent Claims, p. 45).

input: Ano mangyayari kung fraudulent ang claim?
output: Walang babayaran ang Company sa claim na yun at pwede nilang i-terminate agad ang policy. Fraud din ang sinadyang maling info sa application at pwede ring i-terminate agad (Fraud at Fraudulent Claims, p. 45).

input: Is there optional cover for jewelry, watches or tablets?
output: Yes, the optional Valuable Items Benefit covers jewelry, watches, touchscreen tablets, paintings and cameras up to PHP 50,000 (PHP 10,000 per item), only if shown in your Policy Schedule. Items must be declared when the policy is issued, kept in the hotel safe or worn/carried at the time of loss, and supported by original receipts and proof of ownership (Optional Benefit B, p. 39).

input: May optional cover ba para sa alahas, relo o tablet?
output: Oo, ang optional Valuable Items Benefit ay sumasagot sa alahas, relo, touchscreen tablet, painting at camera hanggang PHP 50,000 (PHP 10,000 bawat item), kung nakasaad lamang sa iyong Policy Schedule. Dapat ideklara ang mga ito sa pag-isyu ng policy, nasa safe ng hotel o suot/dala noong nawala, at may orihinal na resibo at patunay ng pagmamay-ari (Optional Benefit B, p. 39).

input: May optional cover ba para sa jewelry, watch o tablet?
output: Yes, ang optional Valuable Items Benefit ay nagco-cover ng jewelry, watches, tablets, paintings at cameras up to PHP 50,000 (PHP 10,000 per item), kung nasa Policy Schedule mo. Dapat declared sa pag-issue ng policy, nasa hotel safe o suot/dala mo nung nawala, at may original receipts at proof of ownership (Optional Benefit B, p. 39).

input: Can I buy cover for skiing or sports on my trip?
output: Yes, the optional Sports Activities Benefit extends only the Section 1 medical benefits to non-professional sports and winter sports, excluding competitive and extra hazardous sports. The first PHP 5,000 (peso policy) or USD 100 (dollar policy) of each occurrence is not paid (Optional Benefit A, p. 39). Skiing, ski jumping and ski mountaineering remain excluded (Definition 68, p. 11).

input: Pwede ba akong bumili ng cover para sa skiing o sports sa aking biyahe?
output: Oo, ang optional Sports Activities Benefit ay nagpapalawig lamang ng Section 1 medical benefits sa hindi propesyonal na sports at winter sports, hindi kasama ang competitive at extra hazardous sports. Hindi babayaran ang unang PHP 5,000 (peso policy) o USD 100 (dollar policy) sa bawat pangyayari (Optional Benefit A, p. 39). Nananatiling hindi sagot ang skiing, ski jumping at ski mountaineering (Definition 68, p. 11).

input: Pwede ba ako bumili ng add-on para sa skiing or sports?
output: Yes, ang optional Sports Activities Benefit ay nag-e-extend lang ng Section 1 medical sa non-professional at winter sports, excluding competitive at extra hazardous sports. Hindi babayaran ang first PHP 5,000 (peso policy) o USD 100 (dollar policy) per occurrence (Optional Benefit A, p. 39). Excluded pa rin ang skiing, ski jumping at ski mountaineering (Definition 68, p. 11).

section: Optional Benefit D - Tourist Spots above 2,500 m
input: Am I covered when visiting high-altitude places like Machu Picchu?
output: Only with the optional Tourist Spots above 2,500 m benefit, which extends Section 1 medical benefits to places like Cusco and Machu Picchu, excluding travellers aged 60 and above. It must be declared with your itinerary before the trip, and is limited to 10% of your Medical Expense limit (Optional Benefit D, p. 39).

section: Optional Benefit D - Tourist Spots above 2,500 m
input: Sagot ba ako kapag bumisita sa matataas na lugar gaya ng Machu Picchu?
output: Kung may optional Tourist Spots above 2,500 m benefit lamang, na nagpapalawig ng Section 1 medical benefits sa mga lugar gaya ng Cusco at Machu Picchu, hindi kasama ang edad 60 pataas. Dapat itong ideklara kasama ang itinerary bago ang biyahe, at hanggang 10% lamang ng iyong Medical Expense limit (Optional Benefit D, p. 39).

section: Optional Benefit D - Tourist Spots above 2,500 m
input: Covered ba ako pag pumunta sa high altitude places like Machu Picchu?
output: Kung may optional Tourist Spots above 2,500 m benefit ka lang, na nag-e-extend ng Section 1 medical sa places like Cusco at Machu Picchu, excluding ages 60 and above. Dapat i-declare kasama ang itinerary bago ang trip, at up to 10% lang ng Medical Expense limit mo (Optional Benefit D, p. 39).

input: Is a cruise trip covered?
output: With the optional Cruise benefit, Section 1 extends to international cruise programs that start from the Philippines by cruise, or by commercial flight with no side trips to the cruise port. Cruise cancellation, curtailment, delay, cabin baggage loss (21 days to be considered lost), personal accident and liability follow your policy limits. Missed departures due to late arrival at the port are excluded (Optional Benefit F, p. 40).

input: Sagot ba ang biyahe sa cruise?
output: Sa optional Cruise benefit, umaabot ang Section 1 sa international cruise program na nagsisimula sa Pilipinas sakay ng cruise, o sa commercial flight nang walang ibang dinaanan papunta sa pantalan. Ang cruise cancellation, curtailment, delay, pagkawala ng bagahe sa cabin (21 araw bago ituring na nawala), personal accident at liability ay ayon sa limits ng iyong policy. Hindi sagot ang naiwang cruise dahil huli kang dumating sa pantalan (Optional Benefit F, p. 40).

input: Covered ba ang cruise trip?
output: Sa optional Cruise benefit, covered ng Section 1 ang international cruise na nag-start sa Pilipinas by cruise, o by commercial flight na walang side trips papunta sa port. Ang cruise cancellation, curtailment, delay, cabin baggage loss (21 days bago considered lost), personal accident at liability ay base sa policy limits mo. Excluded kung naiwan ka ng cruise dahil late ka dumating sa port (Optional Benefit F, p. 40).

input: How much is the exact medical limit of my plan?
output: The exact benefit amounts are in your own Policy Schedule, Confirmation of Insurance or Certificate of Insurance, which is not part of the general policy wording I have. Please check your Policy Schedule or contact Prudential Guarantee customer care (customercare@prudentialguarantee.com) (Definition 8, p. 5).

input: Magkano eksakto ang medical limit ng aking plan?
output: Ang eksaktong halaga ng benepisyo ay nasa iyong sariling Policy Schedule, Confirmation of Insurance o Certificate of Insurance, na hindi kasama sa pangkalahatang policy wording na hawak ko. Pakitingnan ang iyong Policy Schedule o makipag-ugnayan sa customer care ng Prudential Guarantee (customercare@prudentialguarantee.com) (Definition 8, p. 5).

input: Magkano exactly ang medical limit ng plan ko?
output: Nasa sarili mong Policy Schedule, Confirmation of Insurance o Certificate of Insurance ang exact amounts, na wala sa general policy wording na hawak ko. Paki-check ang Policy Schedule mo o contact ang Prudential Guarantee customer care (customercare@prudentialguarantee.com) (Definition 8, p. 5).

input: How much does Travel Shield cost?
output: Premium prices are not stated in the policy wording, so I can't quote them. Please check Prudential Guarantee's website or an accredited agent or broker for a quote.

input: Magkano ang Travel Shield?
output: Hindi nakasaad sa policy wording ang presyo ng premium, kaya hindi ko ito maibibigay. Pakitingnan ang website ng Prudential Guarantee o isang accredited na ahente o broker para sa quotation.

input: Magkano ang premium ng Travel Shield?
output: Wala sa policy wording ang premium prices, kaya hindi ko ma-quote. Paki-check ang website ng Prudential Guarantee o accredited agent o broker para sa quote.

input: Which country should I visit for my vacation?
output: I can only answer questions about the Travel Shield policy and help you file a claim. For travel recommendations, please use a travel guide. Ask me anything about your coverage!

input: Anong bansa ang dapat kong bisitahin para sa bakasyon?
output: Mga tanong lamang tungkol sa Travel Shield policy ang kaya kong sagutin at tulungan kang mag-file ng claim. Para sa rekomendasyon sa paglalakbay, gumamit ng travel guide. Magtanong ka tungkol sa iyong coverage!

input: Saan magandang mag-travel for vacation?
output: Travel Shield policy questions at claim filing lang ang kaya kong i-assist. Para sa travel recommendations, mas okay ang travel guide. Tanong ka lang about sa coverage mo!
